body:
## What

Every built-in `xs:*` constructor gains its XPath 4.0 arity-0 focus form (spec PR661): `xs:T()` takes the **context item** as the implicit cast argument — `'42' ! xs:integer()`, `xs:unsignedLong()` over a max-ulong context. Lands at the frozen `XPath40` level (NOT experimental).

## How

- `FunctionLibrary` static ctor auto-registers an arity-0 counterpart for every registered `xs:*#1` constructor (flagged `IsXPath40Only` → hidden from 3.1 templates; `fn:function-lookup` sees them only at 4.0).
- `XsFocusCtor`: XPDY0002 with no context item; otherwise the existing cast (FOTY0013 maps/functions, FORG0001 lexical, XPTY0004 wrong source type); QName delegates to the namespace-aware arity-1 constructor.
- **Version gate made arity-aware** (required: the arity-0 entries share names with the 3.1 arity-1 forms) — the name sets are now pre-filters; the resolved signature decides. Canonical-prefix fallback extended with `xs`.
- Harness: `assert-type xs:unsignedLong` accepts decimal-backed values carrying the annotation (integers are `long`-backed; max-ulong is decimal-backed by design).

## Verification

- Per-set: misc-FocusConstructors **153/0/0** → enters the gate (now **213 sets**)
- `dotnet test Bosak.sln -c Release`: **3,541/0** exit 0 (+40 new tests: 24 FocusConstructorTests + 13 VersionGate rows)
- QT3: **31,142/0/679** exit 0 · XSLT smoke: **162/0/26**
- Gate-only: **7,715/0/1,833, exit 0, 213 sets** (+153 reconciles exactly)
title: feat(req123): XPath 4.0 focus constructors — arity-0 xs:* constructors take the context item (PR661), arity-aware version gate, gate → 213 sets
